name: post_st_structure_recovery_v1
purpose: Known-CIF structure AND amplitude recovery of the current complete predictor, not enterprise validation or model promotion.
primary_predictor: mean of three 32-tree seed predictions (96 trees)
signal_location: 7 distinct coordinates uniformly sampled independently of outcomes per data repetition; same mapping across scenarios

truth.target: additive:.18+.04*z0+.03*z1; pair adds.05*z0*z1; pure_pair:.18+.04*z2+.05*z0*z1; rare:.06+.01*z0+.01*z1+.02*z0*z1; triple additionally+.04*z4*z5*z6
truth.event_times: conditional cause sampled from endpoint probabilities; common truncated exponential and ceil to positive integer days
truth.censoring: independent ceil exponential with mean730/censor, administratively capped730; event wins integer-day ties
truth.correlation: second true-pair coordinate copies first with probability.7, otherwise independent; margins unchanged

primary_metrics: 24m cause1 true-pair signed projection coefficient / true coefficient
exact function L2 error and RMS
secondary_metrics: raw vs parent-shrunk from same fitted partition
true triple recovery and spurious higher-order energy
logical cells including missing; factored bytes; times; memory
recovery_reference: Known population marginal product, analytic interval masses/moments; only recentering changes, never predictions. Correlated scenario joint prediction evaluated separately.
amplitude: Coefficient projection onto known centered monomial; for binary this is complete component amplitude. Continuous projection is supplemented by exact L2 error/RMS, not asserted to characterize every step-function shape.
uncertainty: 50 independent data repetitions; mean, SD, MCSE, t-based95% mean intervals and paired q2-minus-unrestricted intervals. Seeds are not independent datasets. No result-dependent significance or tuning.

validation.probability: all native-time leaves plus positive averaging; no clipping
validation.reconstruction_scope: all training+5000 test rows at365/730days;32 deterministic training/test probe rows at all native times; explicit component sum on4 probes; full orders<=4
validation.reload: native JSON gzip round trip and function NPZ; exact comparison
validation.pairing: same X/outcomes/company bootstrap multiplicities/eligible features per seed/tree
validation.pilots: 2 independent repetitions10001/10002, one seed42 each:pair_small and continuous_pair_large; complete node replay including raw parent AJ and candidate scores

budget.pool: oliver+lemon Slurm; dynamic P/E-aware affinity; NFS

boundaries: No new parameter search; current reference unchanged
No causal identification from known statistical DGP
No missing-data or all possible economic regimes validation
Unrestricted comparator is same depth4 implementation, not external standard RSF
Failures retained; publication-only recovery cannot refit
